user.title: AMiT PLC (WebSocket)
user.description: Connect to an AMiT station. You can add several controllers. Variables are added afterwards: Settings → Devices & services → AMiT PLC → Configure.

data.username: User (only if users are defined in DetStudio)
data.name: Controller name (e.g. Boiler room)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the PLC (check IP, port, user/password).

abort.already_configured: This PLC (IP and port) is already configured.

init.title: AMiT PLC variables
init.description:
Current variables:
{variables}

Polling interval: {interval} ms

Changes are saved automatically. Press "Done" to close.

add_variable.title: Add variable (1/2)
add_variable.description: Pick a variable from the PLC list ({count} found) or type its name exactly as in DetStudio.

details.title: Add variable (2/2)
details.description: Variable: {variable} (PLC type: {type}). Choose how it appears in Home Assistant. Unit, class and decimals apply to numbers only. Min, max and step apply to analog outputs (slider) only.

error.empty: Name and PLC variable name are required.
error.duplicate: This variable is already added with this type.
error.bad_range: Minimum must be below maximum and step above 0.
